toml:
# Celeste IOD end to end (optional preset): the E5 configuration #1 signal -> a Celeste IOD
# pass -> the Celeste-style navigation message -> GPS + Galileo + Celeste IOD fused fix.
#
# This file uses the Celeste IOD preset (src/celeste_iod.rs), whose signal parameters and
# message content were presented at the ESA NAVISP (Navigation Innovation and Support
# Programme) LEO-PNT workshop, 2026. It is one of the scenarios withheld with that file; the
# same chain runs without any Celeste data in leo-pnt-end-to-end.toml and
# xona-pulsar-end-to-end.toml.
#
# - Signal: E5#1 "Classical Pilot" with data option PfA (pilot BPSK(10), data BPSK(1), 51.15 MHz
#   transmit bandwidth; presented at the ESA NAVISP LEO-PNT workshop, 2026). The 50/50 power
#   split and the code lengths are assumptions.
# - Pass: a user at ESTEC (Noordwijk) watches a Celeste IOD satellite (510 km sun-synchronous,
#   public orbit) peak at 75 deg; the E5 band of the Celeste link preset carries the design.
# - Navigation message: the Celeste IOD message preset (Galileo Keplerian set with
#   along-track, cross-track and radial corrections, 300 s fit), fitted at the pass
#   satellite's orbit; 0.25 m of orbit-determination and clock error is added as a
#   representative decimetre-level figure (no Celeste figure is public).
# - Positioning: GPS and Galileo with the two IOD satellites, which add geometry only while
#   in view.
#
# MODELLED: every stage keeps its own label.
#
# calibrated_peak_cn0_dbhz = 57.5  (the peak of the pass shown at the workshop; read by
# tests/leo_pnt_chain.rs so that no withholdable number lives outside the preset files)
kind = "leo-pnt-chain"
name = "Celeste IOD end to end"
seed = 4
signal_design = "celeste-iod-e5-1-pfa"
od_sisre_m = 0.25

[[signal.signals]]
name = "celeste-iod-e5-1-pfa"
system = "Celeste IOD"
source = "WORKSHOP"
source_ref = "presented at the ESA NAVISP LEO-PNT workshop, 2026"
centre_mhz = 1191.795
tx_bandwidth_mhz = 51.15
allocation = "rnss"
orbit_altitude_km = 510.0
notes = "E5#1 Classical Pilot, data option PfA."

[[signal.signals.components]]
role = "pilot"
modulation = "BPSK(10)"
power_fraction = 0.5
code_length_chips = 10230
note = "power split and code length assumed"

[[signal.signals.components]]
role = "data"
modulation = "BPSK(1)"
power_fraction = 0.5
code_length_chips = 1023
note = "PfA; power split and code length assumed"

[pass]
epoch = "2026-09-28T08:00:00"
duration_s = 600.0
step_s = 2.0

[pass.user]
environment = "ground"
lat_deg = 52.218
lon_deg = 4.420
height_m = 5.0

[[pass.satellite]]
id = "Celeste-IOD"
system = "celeste-iod"
bands = ["E5"]
max_elevation_deg = 75.0
tca_s = 300.0

[[pass.satellite.band]]
name = "E5"
signal = "celeste-iod-e5-1-pfa"

[pass.gnss]
constellation = "galileo"
band = "E1"

[navmsg]
preset = "celeste-iod"

[navmsg.trade]
span_s = 1200.0

[fusion]
mode = "joint"
duration_s = 5700.0
step_s = 30.0

[fusion.user]
lat_deg = 52.22
lon_deg = 4.42
height_m = 5.0

[fusion.joint]
max_leo_sweep = 2

[[fusion.system]]
name = "GPS"
preset = "gps-baseline"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]

[[fusion.system]]
name = "Galileo"
preset = "galileo"
cn0_dbhz = [38.0, 48.0]
isb_ns = 12.0

[[fusion.system]]
name = "Celeste IOD"
leo_preset = "celeste-iod"
signal = "E5"
clock = "known"
summary:
Celeste IOD end to end
  signal celeste-iod-e5-1-pfa (presented at the ESA NAVISP LEO-PNT workshop, 2026), tracked pilot at 10.230 Mchip/s, C/N0 offset -2.91 dB
  pass Celeste-IOD 510 km: tracked C/N0 peak 54.6 dB-Hz, code jitter median 0.151 m; C/N0 line 24.3 + 33.5 sin(el) dB-Hz
  message kepler-rac 300 s fit / 300 s update: representation SISRE 0.857 mm RMS (orbit 0.430 mm), with 0.250 m orbit determination: 0.250 m handed on
  fused fix: GNSS only PDOP 1.15 RMS 3D 1.50 m -> GNSS + LEO PDOP 1.15 RMS 3D 1.48 m
  10 values handed between stages. MODELLED.
